Use a repository URL or owner/repository. Only public repositories are supported. Submission does not verify ownership or guarantee a featured position. You must have permission to share any material you supply.

Your submissions

The submission worker is scheduled every 15 minutes. GitHub scheduling delays or an existing catalogue sync can increase the wait. Temporary errors are retried automatically. Screenshots are added by the regular catalogue workflow.
